blurb: Guests can visit the West Highland taproom to enjoy a wide selection of craft beers including lagers, IPAs, barrel aged beers, and non-alcoholic options. The brewery offers monthly tours providing an inside look at the brewing process with beer tastings. The taproom features a spacious indoor area, outdoor patio, and mezzanine in Denver's West Highland neighborhood.
extraNote: Closed-toed shoes required for brewery tour participation · West Highland taproom, 32nd & Mead, walk East two blocks to Lowell then one block north, Denver, CO
